rows.item_description: Removing the sunset on changes to the unemployment insurance voluntary contribution program. (Remote Testimony Available).
Including protected classes in the Washington equal pay and opportunities act. (Remote Testimony Available).

Reducing the number of days that a worker's temporary total disability must continue to receive industrial insurance compensation for the day of an injury and the three-day period following the injury. (Remote Testimony Available).
Protecting the rights of workers to refrain from attending meetings or listening to their employer's speech on political or religious matters. (Remote Testimony Available).
Relieving individuals from paying interest on certain unemployment insurance overpayment assessments. (Remote Testimony Available).
